description: This script defines platform-specific functions for checking the image, performing upgrades, and copying configurations based on the board name for the OpenWRT firmware platform.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is compatible with the platform based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs platform-specific upgrade procedures based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration specific to certain board models.
